9. Where an individual is arrested for, but not charged with, a qualifying offence, their DNA
profile and fingerprint record will normally be deleted. However, the police can apply to the
Biometrics Commissioner for permission to retain their DNA profile and fingerprint record
for a period of 3 years. The application must be made within 28 days of the decision not to
proceed with a prosecution.
